other_conditions: The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant must be a disabled (differently‑abled) student.
The applicant must be registered for PhD research at any recognized university in India after an interview with the Research Degree Committee.
The applicant must have obtained minimum qualifying marks in their postgraduate degree as specified by the University Grants Commission guidelines.
Only 10 students are awarded the scholarship each year.
benefits_summary: Differently‑abled PhD students receive a scholarship of ₹16,000 per month, amounting to ₹1,92,000 per year.
